name: build
about: The avatar walks to the spot, hammers and stacks pieces busily while the new thing grows bit by bit, then steps back and cheers at the finished thing.
code:
const spot = args.at || me.ahead(2.5)
yield* me.walkTo(spot, { near: 1.5 })
yield* me.turnTo(spot)
let it = args.thing ? w.make(args.thing, { x: spot.x, z: spot.z }) : null
const full = it ? it.scale : 1
if (it) it.scale = full * 0.1
me.feel('happy')
me.say({ en: 'Bang bang!', fi: 'Pum pum!' })
for (let i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
  yield* me.poseTo({ armR: { swing: 2.6, bend: 0.5 }, lean: -0.1 }, 0.15)
  yield* me.poseTo({ armR: { swing: 0.6, bend: 0.2 }, lean: 0.35, squash: 0.9 }, 0.12)
  w.sound('drum')
  w.puff({ x: spot.x, y: 0.2, z: spot.z, kind: i % 2 ? 'dust' : 'spark', count: 8 })
  if (it) {
    const a = it.scale, b = full * (0.1 + 0.9 * i / 6)
    yield* w.during(0.25, (k) => { it.scale = w.lerp(a, b, w.ease(k)) })
  } else yield* w.wait(0.2)
}
yield* me.rest(0.2)
yield* me.walkTo(me.ahead(-2))
yield* me.turnTo(spot)
w.sound('yay')
w.puff({ x: spot.x, y: 0.5, z: spot.z, kind: 'confetti', count: 20 })
me.feel('happy')
me.say(it ? { en: `Tadaa, ${it.name}!`, fi: `Tadaa, ${it.name}!` } : { en: 'Tadaa!', fi: 'Tadaa!' })
yield* me.poseTo({ armL: { swing: 3 }, armR: { swing: 3 } }, 0.2)
yield* me.jump(0.5)
yield* me.rest()
